policies.scope: Live scoring ensemble — SQPE_IMPROVEMENT_MDS_V1 profile, all UK runners
policies.actions: Scores runners using VP = (0.45 * sqpe_v17 + 0.12 * improvement_score + 0.10 * MDS) / 0.67. Excludes place_prob, longshot_score, release_window_score, comment_intel_score from VP numerator.
policies.name: Live Scoring Policy — SQPE_IMPROVEMENT_MDS_V1

frozen_not_weighted.longshot_score: FROZEN — FREEZE_CANDIDATE (ROI=-0.065); calculated, stored, excluded from VP; SP>=10 gate still used for tier X classification

stored_only.release_window_score: STORED_ONLY — weight 0.00, in disabled set for both profiles; calculated, stored, not weighted
stored_only.comment_intel_score: STORED_ONLY — weight 0.00, in disabled set for both profiles; calculated, stored, not weighted

policies.scope: Shadow-only scoring policy — SHADOW_SAFE_V2 weight profile
policies.conditions: Applied in shadow scoring context only; not promoted to live ensemble
policies.actions: Scores runners with high SQPE anchor (0.80). Dangerous/red-flag sidecars removed. Evidence accumulation only — no VP composite contribution.
policies.name: Shadow Safe V2 Policy
policies.notes: High SQPE anchor. Dangerous/red-flag sidecars removed. Not yet promoted.

policies.scope: VP band signal gate — all scored UK runners
policies.conditions: Applied to every scored runner after VP composite is computed
policies.actions: Classifies runners into SUPPRESS / NOISY / PROMISING / PROVEN bands. Primary live gate: VP >= 0.30. Proven gate: VP >= 0.30 AND Tier A.
policies.name: VP Band Signal Gate

policies.scope: Tier classification (A/B/C/D/X) — all scored UK runners
policies.conditions: Applied after VP composite is computed; tier assigned per VP + sidecar signal combination
policies.actions: Assigns tier label A/B/C/D/X. Tier A = PROVEN signal gate. B-tier split applied: B_VP>=0.30 = WATCHLIST, B_VP<0.30 = SUPPRESS. Tier X = excluded from main audit.
policies.name: Tier Classification (A/B/C/D/X)

tiers.X: EXCLUDED — 142 X-tier excluded from main audit

policies.conditions: Applied when VP >= 0.40 threshold triggers. SP_2X and Shortprice sub-lanes tracked separately.
policies.actions: All lanes remain WATCH_ONLY until evidence gates passed. No staking. SP_2X gate: n >= 50 required. Shortprice gate: n >= 150 required.
policies.name: VP40 / VP40_TIER_A Watch Policy

policies.scope: VeloExecutionBridge — paper execution ledger, directive routing
policies.conditions: Applied on every scored verdict passing through execution_bridge.py. Hard runtime guards enforce simulation_only=True always.
policies.actions: Routes verdicts to directive tiers: BLOCKED / CHAOS_CONTAINMENT_MODE / POWER_ANCHOR_MODE / FAVOURITE_LIABILITY_MODE / MULTI_THREAT_ZONE_MODE / WATCH_ONLY. No live staking at any threshold — operator decision required at every promotion gate.
policies.name: VeloExecutionBridge Safety Policy

power_anchor_promotion_gates.note: No automatic promotion at any threshold — operator decision required

policies.scope: Router shadow lane evidence accumulation — V1_BASE, V2_CLASS4_ONLY, V6_GOLD_SEAM lanes
policies.conditions: Applied to every verdict passing through router shadow audit. Evidence accumulation only — no staking, no router rule changes.
policies.actions: Classifies verdicts into lanes. Tracks n, SR, ROI per lane. Applies freeze rule: ROI < 0 at n >= 20 OR Frame < 70% at n >= 20. Promotion gates require operator approval.
policies.name: Router Shadow Lane Evidence Policy

lane_promotion_gates.SHADOW_CANDIDATE: n >= 30 AND ROI positive AND Frame > 75%
lane_promotion_gates.FREEZE: ROI < 0 at n >= 20 OR Frame < 70% at n >= 20

policies.hard_rule: No router rule changes. Evidence accumulation only.
